run_codespell_ignore_lines_generator: run the script with a codespell error log file path to generate ignore lines
parse_codespell_errors_to_source_lines: parse a codespell error output file and extract the actual source lines that triggered warnings
generate_codespell_ignore_lines_file: generate a .codespell-ignore-lines file by piping script output after running codespell on all files
extract_source_lines_from_error_log: extract and deduplicate source code lines from a codespell error log using filename and line number
cache_source_files_for_lookup: cache source file contents in memory to avoid repeated file reads when processing multiple errors from the same file
